title: ResolvedProfile
description: snapshot/resolved-profile.json -- the effective assessment profile after precedence resolution (ADR-026: built-in defaults, then profile file, then named CLI parameters; no secrets, script, or implicit environment-variable overrides).

precedenceTrace.description: One entry per effective setting, recording which precedence layer supplied its final value -- exists so a resolved profile is auditable rather than opaque.

settingPath.description: Dotted path into 'settings' this entry documents.

value.description: The resolved value at this path. No constraint on shape here -- validated by whatever schema governs the specific setting.

settings.description: The fully resolved, effective settings tree actually used for this run. No environment-variable or implicit override is represented here -- ADR-026 forbids that as an input source, so there is nothing to record.
